svg.title: Five Paid Research Niches Fund the Base Case
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-service-rail-yield; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Five Paid Research Niches Fund the Base Case; subtitle: Illustrative annual service-fee yield per distinct firm engagement; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Bars represent annual operator service revenue in USD, not statutory award percentages, expected recoveries, or empirical market prices. Each niche contributes one distinct engagement to the five-engagement Base model; total revenue is $487,500.; caption: Price around reproducible evidence work and counsel demand. A payment rail determines the research problem, not automatic award eligibility. Invoice support services independently of whether counsel files a complaint or an agency takes action.; stages: label: CMS Part B/D Support; value: $60,000 annually; $5,000 monthly service equivalent; numeric value: 60000.0; detail: Reconcile provider identifiers, billing periods, specialty cohorts, and payment records. Aggregate utilization anomalies require claim-level corroboration before supporting a particularized FCA allegation.; label: Open Payments Corroboration; value: $75,000 annually; $6,250 monthly service equivalent; numeric value: 75000.0; detail: Resolve manufacturer, recipient, and payment identities against relevant utilization records. A disclosed payment does not itself prove an unlawful inducement or a resulting false reimbursement claim.; label: Procurement and Customs; value: $90,000 annually; $7,500 monthly service equivalent; numeric value: 90000.0; detail: Link procurement representations and authorized shipment evidence to specific contracts or entries. Test alternative explanations including amendments, valuation methods, timing, and entity mismatches.; label: SEC Evidence Analytics; value: $112,500 annually; $9,375 monthly service equivalent; numeric value: 112500.0; detail: Provide issuer-event reconstruction and original-analysis support. Counsel evaluates 15 U.S.C. § 78u-6 and 17 CFR § 240.21F-4; SEC award percentages generally run 10%–30%, not the FCA intervention schedule.; label: IRS Evidence Analytics; value: $150,000 annually; $12,500 monthly service equivalent; numeric value: 150000.0; detail: Reconcile lawful records to tax periods and asserted underpayments. Counsel tests 26 U.S.C. § 7623(b), including amounts exceeding $2 million and, for individual taxpayers, gross income exceeding $200,000 in a qualifying taxable year.

rect.title: label: CMS Part B/D Support; value: $60,000 annually; $5,000 monthly service equivalent; numeric value: 60000.0; detail: Reconcile provider identifiers, billing periods, specialty cohorts, and payment records. Aggregate utilization anomalies require claim-level corroboration before supporting a particularized FCA allegation.

label: Open Payments Corroboration; value: $75,000 annually; $6,250 monthly service equivalent; numeric value: 75000.0; detail: Resolve manufacturer, recipient, and payment identities against relevant utilization records. A disclosed payment does not itself prove an unlawful inducement or a resulting false reimbursement claim.

label: Procurement and Customs; value: $90,000 annually; $7,500 monthly service equivalent; numeric value: 90000.0; detail: Link procurement representations and authorized shipment evidence to specific contracts or entries. Test alternative explanations including amendments, valuation methods, timing, and entity mismatches.

label: SEC Evidence Analytics; value: $112,500 annually; $9,375 monthly service equivalent; numeric value: 112500.0; detail: Provide issuer-event reconstruction and original-analysis support. Counsel evaluates 15 U.S.C. § 78u-6 and 17 CFR § 240.21F-4; SEC award percentages generally run 10%–30%, not the FCA intervention schedule.

label: IRS Evidence Analytics; value: $150,000 annually; $12,500 monthly service equivalent; numeric value: 150000.0; detail: Reconcile lawful records to tax periods and asserted underpayments. Counsel tests 26 U.S.C. § 7623(b), including amounts exceeding $2 million and, for individual taxpayers, gross income exceeding $200,000 in a qualifying taxable year.

text.title: Assumptions: Bars represent annual operator service revenue in USD, not statutory award percentages, expected recoveries, or empirical market prices. Each niche contributes one distinct engagement to the five-engagement Base model; total revenue is $487,500.
